concepts.gloss_en: The Aramaic Targum / Targum-language (leshon Targum), a mixture of good and evil like the Tree of Knowledge, through which the Holy Tongue is built up

reason_for_human: All 10 occurrences refer to the same thing — the Aramaic Targum / leshon Targum, equated throughout with the Tree of Knowledge (good+evil mixed), Nogah, and the means of perfecting Holy Tongue. התרגום is the identical word with a grammatical definite article referring back to 'the Targum' just mentioned in context, not an archetype-vs-generic distinction, so it merges cleanly. No homograph risk here.
